subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should Feishu authorized command-only text messages restore the documented fast path for stateful commands like `/stop` and `/new`, or should Feishu only fast-path a safe local subset such as `/status`?
rationale: Current main has partial behavior and the available PRs choose different safety boundaries; deciding which stateful commands may bypass active-run queue/session ordering is a maintainer policy choice rather than a mechanical patch decision.

options.title: Restore reported commands
options.body: Make authorized Feishu command-only text turns for `/stop`, `/new`, and `/status` bypass the active-run queue with Feishu-owned tests and live proof.

options.title: Fast-path safe local subset
options.body: Limit immediate handling to local read-only/status-style commands and keep `/stop` and `/new` tracked as a separate explicit design or bug decision.

options.title: Require explicit command allowlists
options.body: Keep the fail-closed behavior for stateful Feishu text commands and update docs/setup guidance so operators know they must configure command authorization.

recommendation.title: Restore reported commands
recommendation.body: Make authorized Feishu command-only text turns for `/stop`, `/new`, and `/status` bypass the active-run queue with Feishu-owned tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice crosses the shared command authorization gate and Feishu command-turn semantics, where steipete has the strongest feature-history signal.
